instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot. Indoors on a brown fabric sofa next to a window with green plants, the blonde woman in the black top and white pants (R1) sits facing right, extending her right arm to touch the forehead of the woman with long curly dark hair in a checkered shirt and denim shorts (R2). The curly-haired woman (R2) sits cross-legged on the right, facing left, calmly receiving the touch. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene with a neutral color palette.
